decisions.reason: Two years in, the core-business safety shoe line is still cheap to hold through in-house production and existing distribution, and nothing so far shows its value won't be realized.
The comfort insole costs little to keep alongside the core footwear, though overlap with the other new insoles keeps a moderate chance of consolidation.
The supportive insole remains a low-cost option with unresolved value, but as the least differentiated of three insoles it is the most likely to be pruned.
Its own website page signals favourable early prospects, so the ergonomic series is an option worth holding and possibly expanding.
Certification and tender cycles mean the value of firefighter boots resolves slowly, so dropping them now would give up the option too early.
As the flagship shown on the home page, the moulded insole is a strategic commitment that management will keep developing.
